model.name: RbTraceTree.renderCurrentSprintEagerLazy
model.description: Render the trace tree with exactly TWO top-level nodes: (1) CurrentSprint node at top; (2) an eager-lazy Sprints collection — sprint NODES render eager, each sprint's TASKS load LAZILY on expand (structure-eager/payload-lazy, like R26 federation). Keeps the tree scalable as sprints accumulate.
